name: Auto-Respond
tagline: AI that answers calls and texts across channels and books the appointment for you
verdict: Auto-Respond is a focused answering and lead-response tool for local businesses that lose jobs to slow follow-up. The multi-channel coverage, fast reply time, and direct calendar booking address a real pain point for owner-operators, though the per-channel, per-minute pricing structure means the real cost depends heavily on how many channels a business turns on.
